one who lances an abscess on Shabbat: if to make it an opening, he is liable

the second of the three exempt-and-permitted: lancing an abscess [to let out its fluid]

if for healing, he is liable
the third of the three exempt-and-permitted: trapping a snake [so that it not bite]
